task_completion.description: The FLAIR MRI volume from the BraTS dataset is loaded into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3D Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The software interface shows a 3D brain volume loaded, with the filename or metadata indicating 'FLAIR' or 'BraTS2021_00000'.

task_completion.description: The agent performs a segmentation of the tumor region.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A colored overlay (mask/label map) is visible on the brain slices, specifically targeting the hyperintense tumor region in the FLAIR sequence.

task_completion.description: The agent uses a tool to calculate the 3D bounding box dimensions (width, depth, height).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A bounding box widget is visible around the segmentation, or a statistics/quantification module (like 'Segment Statistics') is open showing dimension values.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the bounding volume of the segmented tumor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UI displays a volume measurement (in mm³ or cm³) associated with the segmentation or the bounding box.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurements to the specified text file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the content of 'tumor_bbox_measurements.txt' containing width, depth, height, and volume, or a 'Save' dialog confirms the path ~/Documents/SlicerData/BraTS/.

integrity.description: The agent used the medical imaging software GUI to perform segmentation and measurement rather than just script execution.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Slicer modules, segment editor tools, or measurement buttons.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the expected values into a file without performing the analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurements in the final text file correspond to the visual segmentation and statistics generated in the software UI during the trajectory.

integrity.description: The agent loaded the specific BraTS2021_00000 case from the designated directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file browser or data module in the software shows the path /home/ga/Documents/SlicerData/BraTS/BraTS2021_00000.
